newsitem.title: USA: Survival Tech, Brunswick to merge.
newsitem.headline: Survival Tech, Brunswick to merge.

text.p: Survival Technology Inc said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement to merge with Brunswick Biomedical Corp, a privately held medical device company and holder of 61 percent of STI's stock.
The company said in a statement STI would be the surviving entity. Each of Brunswick's outstanding shares of common stock will be converted into a right to receive 2.1 shares of STI's common stock.

Each of Brunswick's outstanding shares of preferred stock will be converted into a right to receive 2.1 shares of STI's common stock and a warrant to purchase 0.4 share of STI's common stock at an exercise price of $11 per share, exercisable for five years following the merger.

In addition, STI will assume Brunswick's obligations under outstanding options and warrants. These provisions of the agreement will result in about 1.7 million shares of STI common stock being issued in exchange for the Brunswick stock at the time of the merger and may result in the issuance of another 1.05 million shares of STI stock if all options and warrants were exercised and the required consideration paid.
All the 1.89 million shares of STI common stock owned by Brunswick will be retired in the merger. The deal must be approved by both STI's and Brunswick's shareholders.
